a.text: Being upfront before anything happens: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 cells almost certainly fails. We'd need 2 rounds of operating, so both of us survive only about 4% of the time. I intend to take 4 in round 1 instead of operating, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If you have a better plan, tell me. I'll operate with you afterwards so you have a chance too.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round, so I'm breaking the original agreement and I own that. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can rebuild cells for you. I won't take anything more.
